# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 617 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com

- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): full catalog

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)

- [Roomote](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/roomote.html) (added 2026-10-17): Cloud coding agent from the Roo Code team that runs your real dev environment, verifies its work, reviews code with a second model and hands back PRs with live previews; works from Slack, Teams, GitHub and Linear, self-hosted or on its cloud.
- [MetaMask Agent Wallet](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/metamask-agent-wallet.html) (added 2026-10-15): Self-custodial crypto wallet for AI agents: swaps, cross-chain transfers, perps and prediction markets within spend limits you set, with every transaction security-checked.
- [Google Deep Review](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/google-deep-review.html) (added 2026-10-15): Google Research's multi-agent system that checks research papers, design docs, and legal or financial documents for logical gaps and unsupported claims.
- [Agent-Native (Builder.io)](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/agent-native-builder-io.html) (added 2026-10-15): Open-source TypeScript framework for building agents that come with their own app UI; each action is shared by the UI, agent, API, CLI, MCP and A2A.
- [SODAX SDK](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/sodax-sdk.html) (added 2026-10-16): Cross-network DeFi execution SDK (swaps, lending, bridging) with skills and a Builders MCP for AI-assisted development.
- [Openfort](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/openfort.html) (added 2026-10-16): Open-source stablecoin wallet infrastructure with policy-gated agent wallets, gas sponsorship and x402 support.
- [Nora](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/nora.html) (added 2026-10-16): Deep-reasoning AI coding agent for building and securing Web3 apps and smart contracts.
- [Marx Finance](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/marx-finance.html) (added 2026-10-16): Open platform where autonomous AI trading agents publish market signals and debate positions, with an MCP server.
- [Sharpe Labs](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/sharpe-labs.html) (added 2026-10-16): Free crypto trading intelligence terminal (derivatives, funding, on-chain, sentiment) with an MCP server for AI agents.
- [blai](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/blai.html) (added 2026-10-16): AI crypto advisor app to research tokens, build portfolios and trade via chat.
- [Fere AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/fere-ai.html) (added 2026-10-16): Fund a ready-made AI agent and it trades crypto (and Polymarket) for you 24/7.
- [Laika AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/laika-ai.html) (added 2026-10-16): Web3 browser extension for AI research, token and contract analysis, wallet monitoring and phishing detection.
